newsitem.title: USA: Nebraska fed cattle market at standstill - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Nebraska fed cattle market at standstill - USDA.

text.p: Trading on slaughter steers and heifers continued at a standstill, USDA said.

Buyer inquiry fair-good, and most bidding $105.00-$106.00 per cwt on a dressed basis. Seller interest light. Many have cattle priced $107.00-$108.00. Last sizeable price test previous Wednesday at $106.00-$107.00.
Slaughter Heifers - No reported sales. Confirmed - None For the week - 2,800
Live basis sales - Equivalent 3 percent shrink delivered and FOB, some FOB 4% shrink. Dressed basis delivered (paid on hot carcass weights)
